textRuns.value: Which filters each backlog measure respects.

Open Backlog EOP: the requests open at most 365 days (R20) at the last in-window date of the period; it responds to Date, Agency, Borough, Complaint, Channel and Age Band, and is blank when a Requests column (Status, ZIP, Descriptor, a flag) is filtered directly.
the same value in every context, computed from Backlog Flow where only Date, Agency and Borough filter it.
eligible openings and exits (closed, or aged out after 365 days) per in-window date; blank under a Complaint, Channel or Age Band filter or a direct filter on a fact column.

Literal.Value: 'Text: which filters each backlog measure respects. Open Backlog EOP responds to date, agency, borough, complaint, channel and age band and is blank under a direct filter on a request column; the Fast measure gives the same value; inflow and outflow are blank where Backlog Flow cannot answer.'
